operations.title: Entry 1408 — Euler Mellin Modes Are Total in the Xi Jet Boundary
operations.summary: One-sided Euler-domain Mellin modes produce all Cauchy jets. Orthogonality yields a meromorphic function with zero open-domain values and hence zero principal parts, proving totality in the full multiplicity boundary.

operations.title: Euler-domain Mellin Cauchy jets are total in the polarized Xi boundary
operations.statement: The normalized jets of G_z(lambda)=1/(lambda-z) are (-1)^k/(lambda-z)^(k+1) and lie in the multiplicity jet Hilbert space. Any vector orthogonal to all z in the open Euler domain defines an identically zero meromorphic function, whose principal parts force all jet coefficients to vanish. Thus the source modes are total.
operations.scope: Conditional positive/self-adjoint interpretation assumes RH; no physical relative-chain pushforward.

operations.title: Cauchy-jet meromorphic principal-part totality test
operations.description: Use the Hilbert-Schmidt zero sum for normal convergence, the identity theorem on the Euler domain, and uniqueness of every pole principal part.
